import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\")
tables = cur.fetchall()
print('Tables:', tables)
for t in tables:
    cur.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info({t[0]})')
    cols = cur.fetchall()
    print(f'Schema for {t[0]}:', cols)
conn.close()
"

python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()

# guidance_upper: GAAP high + all guidance adjustments including currency
# High GAAP diluted EPS = 1.04, add all guidance_adjustments
cur.execute(\"\"\"
  SELECT g.high + (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM guidance_adjustments WHERE fiscal_period = 'Q2FY2025')
  FROM guidance
  WHERE fiscal_period = 'Q2FY2025'
\"\"\")
guidance_upper = cur.fetchone()[0]
print(f'guidance_upper = {guidance_upper}')

# actual non-GAAP diluted EPS
cur.execute(\"SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3 AND measure='Non-GAAP diluted EPS'\")
actual_eps = cur.fetchone()[0]
print(f'actual_eps = {actual_eps}')

# eps_gap
eps_gap = actual_eps - guidance_upper
print(f'eps_gap = {eps_gap}')

# net_income_adjustment = operating expense adjustments - income tax effect
cur.execute(\"SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3 AND category='Operating expense'\")
op_adj = cur.fetchone()[0]
cur.execute(\"SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3 AND category='Income tax expense'\")
tax_adj = cur.fetchone()[0]
net_income_adj = op_adj - tax_adj
print(f'op_adj = {op_adj}, tax_adj = {tax_adj}, net_income_adj = {net_income_adj}')

# adjusted_net_income
cur.execute(\"SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3 AND measure='Net income'\")
gaap_ni = cur.fetchone()[0]
adj_ni = gaap_ni + net_income_adj
print(f'gaap_ni = {gaap_ni}, adj_ni = {adj_ni}')

# Check against reported non-GAAP net income
cur.execute(\"SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3 AND measure='Non-GAAP net income'\")
reported_non_gaap_ni = cur.fetchone()[0]
print(f'reported_non_gaap_ni = {reported_non_gaap_ni}')

# adjusted_net_margin
cur.execute(\"SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-30' AND months=3 AND measure='Total revenues'\")
rev = cur.fetchone()[0]
adj_margin = adj_ni / rev * 100
print(f'adjusted_net_margin = {adj_margin}')
print(f'rev = {rev}')

conn.close()
"
